text:
alice: Starting the canary wedge for cross-region rollout today. Planning 0 -> 1% -> 5% -> 20% over 3h windows. Who's owning smoke/rollback for each region slice? :hourglass_flowing_sand:

release-bot: Scheduled: 2026-06-21 14:00 UTC start. Canary config attached to release r-2026-06-21. Auto-bump disabled.

bob: I can own us-east-1 slice smoke checks for first two windows. Will run smoke checklist and watch infra dashboards.

carlos: I'll take eu-west-1 for 5% and 20% ramps. Will be available for the whole window.

dana: I'll coordinate rollback if anything breaches error budget. Quick note: feature-flag gate is ff/cross-region-wedge (can be toggled per region).

eve: Thanks. Can we confirm the gating metrics and thresholds? Need explicit decide/pause rules.

alice: Good call — gating: (1) error-rate > 0.8% for 2 consecutive 5m windows -> pause, (2) p95 latency increases > 80% baseline -> pause, (3) end-to-end model quality regressions on eval set (score drop > 2pts) -> rollback.

bob: I'll monitor metrics: p50/p95 latency, 5xx rate, tokens/sec, CPU GPU mem. I'll post periodic check-ins.

carlos: Add quick smoke commands for canary owners: run these after each window start to verify routing and KV cache priming:

```
# validate routing
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.test/generate -d '{"prompt":"smoke route check","max_tokens":4}'

# peek health
ssh infra-proxy@canary-east-1 'tail -n 100 /var/log/redwood/serving.log | grep "startup"'
```

release-bot: Rollback playbook link: https://internal.redwood/release-playbooks/canary-rollback. Short form: toggle ff/cross-region-wedge -> scale down canary pool -> re-route traffic to previous model version -> open incident if degraded.

dana: For rollback commands (ops):
```
# disable flag
rbac-cli feature disable ff/cross-region-wedge --region=eu-west-1
# scale down canary
kubectl -n inference scale deploy canary-deploy --replicas=0 --context=eu-west-1
# promote fallback
redwoodctl promote-version --service text-gen --version v1.9.2
```

alice: Timeline: start 14:00 UTC, 14:00-15:00 1% (us-east-1), 15:00-16:00 5% (eu-west-1 join), 16:00-19:00 20% global ramp. We'll pause between windows for 10m to assess.

eve: Naming of cohorts for dashboards? Request we label them: wedge-us-east-1, wedge-eu-west-1, wedge-global-20. Helps filter in console.

bob: Confirmed. I'll tag metrics with cohort=wedge-us-east-1 and add Slack alerts for p95>threshold.

carlos: One more: cache warmup note — first 10m after region join will show higher latency, treat it as expected but still within gating margins. We'll allow a 10% transient p95 uptick during first 10m.

alice: OK good call. Final checklist items: (1) owners assigned (bob, carlos), (2) feature flag ready (dana), (3) rollback commands tested (dana), (4) alerts configured (bob), (5) release window posted to calendar. If no objections let's proceed. :thumbsup:

dana: No objections. I'll stand by for rollback and have runbook open.

eve: I'll be on watch for quality evals, will run quick evals after each window and post scores.

alice: Great — starting at 14:00 UTC. Ping here when each window starts and when we hit 20%.
